query: SELECT pz.id, pz.label, pz.purpose, pz.posX, pz.posY, pz.width, pz.height, pp.label as partLabel, pp.partKey FROM product_zones pz LEFT JOIN product_parts pp ON pz.partId = pp.id WHERE pz.productId = 1380006 ORDER BY pp.partKey, pz.label;
